cs.t: I remember when I was displaying downloaded anime to my Roku TV from my laptop and the TV recognized what I was watching. That was an eerie realization.
cs.th: People sick of being spied on by their smart TV

cs.t: I used to love Roku. I even went through their early developer stuff to play with custom channels. It was clear many years ago that their shift form platform to ad provider was underway. Why can't a company always be amazing at something and just stick to that (looking at you Dropbox)? I have a Roku TV an dmy setup is simple: - Disable wifi on Roku TV - Add Apple TV and connect to router
cs.th: Fox to Buy Roku Streaming Service in $22B Deal

cs.t: Interesting hardware and very informative video. The display is $1,659 and the Pi module is $200. I’ve never bought a TV over $500 and never will. So definitely not for me. I have 3 4k Roku TV’s in my house and found them to be fine performance wise, have minimal ads and just work. Also the Roku iPhone app can be used as a remote.
cs.th: Smarter Than a Smart TV (Raspberry Pi Inside) – Jeff Geerling

cs.t: Wait, what?  Young people are not buying TVs anymore?  I understand not watching terrestrial TV but I've always had like a TV plugged in to my laptop to play games and stream youtube/twich.  More recently I just bought a roku TV and haven't really played much games so phone+roku TV seems sufficient. Completely abandoning TVs but still watching videos of one kind or another seems weird.
